params.text: "Plan each step before calling: one program should gather every read, search, and probe the step needs (Promise.all, or workspace.batch for files; Promise.allSettled for optional probes), and one should make all its edits to different files. Each tool call is a round trip that resends the context. Sequence only dependent work and edits to the same file.",

arguments.label: Replace the Promise.all guideline with plan-and-batch round-trip guidance
